content: Letta MCP tool has a known 120s timeout failure mode; use a 3-step fallback hierarchy to access Letta agent data: 1) Retry the mcp_letta_agents call, 2) Use terminal letta CLI or curl to http://localhost:8283/v1/agents to bypass the MCP layer, 3) If Letta is unreachable, document intended agent structure and create agent creation scripts without live verification.
